description: Shared codebase context for coding agents and humans. Graphify CLI maps a repository's code, docs, PDFs, images and video into a typed knowledge graph, with code parsed locally by tree-sitter, that agents query over MCP or the CLI instead of grepping files. It can build a markdown Wiki from the graph and review pull requests with graph context. Hosted Graphify at graphify.com adds shared team Memory and automatic PR reviews on the same graph.
